text: I used to have a stiff shoulder blade in my back, and conventional medicine didn't help. Then I tried alternative medicine, acupuncture, thinking I had nothing to lose. Surprisingly, after the first three sessions, I didn't feel much, just numbness in my back, no pain. By the fifth and sixth sessions, I started to feel sensation in the painful area. I went through 10 sessions, and the pain completely disappeared and hasn't returned. Even though it took 10 sessions—about seven weeks, with sessions sometimes once or twice a week—the lasting relief was worth it. I can live a normal life now. Thank you so much to Traditional Chinese Medicine for improving my health.
